q: The incident ray, the refracted ray and the ____ all lie in the same plane.
e: The incident ray, the refracted ray and the normal all lie in the same plane. Normal is what this statement is using.

q: For a particular wavelength of light and for a given pair of media, the ratio of the sine of the angle of incidence to the sine of the angle of refraction is a ____.
e: Visible wavelengths are a few hundred nanometres. Colour follows wavelength. For a particular wavelength of light and for a given pair of media, the ratio of the sine of the angle of incidence to the sine of the angle of refraction is a constant.

q: The second law is called ____ since it was so named in honour of its discoverer-Dutch Scientist Willebrord Snell in 1621.
e: Lenses refract. Light is an electromagnetic wave and also a particle. The second law is called Snell's law since it was so named in honour of its discoverer-Dutch Scientist Willebrord Snell in 1621.

q: In refraction of light, the light rays also obey the principle of ____ of light.
e: Superposition: the resultant at a point is the sum of the individual displacements. In refraction of light, the light rays also obey the principle of reversibility of light.

q: The angle between the refracted ray and the normal is called the angle of refraction and is represented by ____.
e: Lenses refract. Light is an electromagnetic wave and also a particle. The angle between the refracted ray and the normal is called the angle of refraction and is represented by r.

q: The laws governing the refraction of light which are obtained from experiments are stated as the ____.
e: Refraction: light bends when the speed changes across a boundary. Snell's law is n1 sin i = n2 sin r. The laws governing the refraction of light which are obtained from experiments are stated as the Laws of Refraction.

q: When light travels from a less dense medium to a more dense medium, the angle of refraction is ____ than the angle of incidence.
e: Lenses refract. Light is an electromagnetic wave and also a particle. When light travels from a less dense medium to a more dense medium, the angle of refraction is smaller than the angle of incidence.

q: When light travels from a more dense medium to a less dense medium, the angle of refraction is ____ than the angle of incidence.
e: Lenses refract. Light is an electromagnetic wave and also a particle. When light travels from a more dense medium to a less dense medium, the angle of refraction is greater than the angle of incidence.
